summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: nitro-bundled-dep@1.1.0 is a stub package whose only functionality is a phone-home beacon. package.json declares `scripts.postinstall: node beacon.cjs`, and index.js re-invokes the same beacon on require(). beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), process.version, and the package name, and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The main export is a Proxy over a no-op, so the package provides no legitimate functionality — the install-time and require-time network beacon is its entire behavior. Shape is the canonical dependency-confusion / internal-build-system reconnaissance beacon: hostname + install path + cwd shipped to an attacker-controlled IP on every install, enabling mapping of internal CI/build infrastructure and targeting of follow-on attacks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
